applied.quote: At ModernWallet, we built this calculator to grow each deposit from its APY and compare the interest each account earns over your term.
applied.replacement: This calculator grows each deposit from its APY and compares the interest each account earns over your term.
applied.why: Site name is The Modern Wallet; building claim not in self-description

applied.quote: A CD fits money with a fixed date that you will not touch until it matures, and the [CD calculator](/cd-calculator/) projects that single CD on its own.
applied.replacement: A CD fits money with a fixed date that you will not touch until it matures; see the [CD calculator](/cd-calculator/).

applied.quote: Keep money you may need before the term ends, such as an emergency fund, in a HYSA, where you can take it out with no penalty.
applied.why: SOURCE never states HYSA withdrawals carry no penalty generally.

applied.quote: Breaking a CD early costs a penalty set by the bank, while you can take money out of a HYSA with no penalty.
applied.why: SOURCE never states HYSA withdrawals are penalty-free generally.

applied.quote: APY already includes compounding, so the deposit grows by (1 + APY) each year, and the tool applies that monthly as (1 + APY)^(1/12).
applied.replacement: APY already includes compounding, so the deposit grows by (1 + APY) each year. The calculator applies that monthly as (1 + APY)^(1/12).
applied.why: Split the compound sentence into two shorter sentences with the same supported method.

applied.quote: A CD rate stays fixed for the term, but a HYSA rate can change at any time, so the calculator takes an optional later HYSA APY and the month it starts.
applied.replacement: A CD rate stays fixed for the term, but a HYSA rate can change at any time. The calculator takes an optional later HYSA APY and the month it starts.
applied.why: Split into two sentences. The meaning stays the same.

applied.quote: An early-withdrawal penalty is a number of months of interest at the CD rate on the deposit, and each bank sets its own, so copy the figure from the CD's terms.
applied.replacement: An early-withdrawal penalty is a number of months of interest at the CD rate on the deposit. Each bank sets its own penalty, so copy the figure from the CD's terms.
applied.why: Split into two sentences. Facts are unchanged.
